ab.paired_record: extra['aster_enh_exp_journal'].records[] carries control_enter/treatment_enter + control_exit/treatment_exit per differing symbol

decision_record.calculation: Fixture (tests/test_harden_edge_batch11_blockers.py): RSI2 — uptrend + two drops, last bar dated the session date: control (forming-inclusive) emits NO entry (partial close dragged through the SMA200 gate), treatment (completed only) emits the designed SPY entry; journal pair control_enter=false/treatment_enter=true. Squeeze — declining completed bars + a forming spike bar, position held: control emits NO exit, treatment emits the close_below_ema20/momentum_nonpositive exit.
decision_record.comparison: Baseline computes RSI2/SMA/squeeze features over bars[-1] even while that bar is still forming (desk evaluates every ~86s through RTH). Comparator: identical bars, features over completed bars only (last bar dated < current ET session dropped).
decision_record.experiment: tests/test_harden_edge_batch11_blockers.py TestTraderCompletedBar: treatment binds both directions (entry + exit), switch OFF reproduces the pre-change forming-bar decisions exactly, paired records land in extra['aster_enh_exp_journal']. Rejection rule: any fixture where ON and OFF agree while a forming bar is present and decision-relevant.
decision_record.mechanism: Perception (stale/partial input): a forming bar's close is not a close — it moves all session, so entries fire and vanish intraday and exits are hidden by a partial print.
decision_record.transfer: The frozen public trader rules (trader_rsi2_public_v1 / trader_squeeze20_public_v1) earn their surplus on completed daily bars; the surplus is captured only if the desk's decision bar is the bar the rule was specified on.

disposition: ENHANCED: completed-bar feature gate (forming bar excluded)
